title: Delete a TikTok account Webhook configuration
content_data:
Use this endpoint to delete an existing configuration for Webhook events related to your TikTok account activities at the developer app level. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/webhook/delete/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | app_id {Required} | string | ID of your developer application.

You can find the App ID by navigating to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | | secret {Required} | string | Secret of your developer application.

You can find the Secret by navigating to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | | event_type {Required} | enum | The type of Webhook event configuration that you want to delete.

Enum values:
  • `VIDEO`: Post publishing events, which provide you with real-time updates on the status of content published via specific TikTok API endpoints.
    • To learn more about the schema and sample payload of the events within this event category, see [Post publishing events](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810515090228226).
  • `COMMENT`: comment update event, including the event `comment.update`.
    • To learn more about the schema and sample payload of the event within this event category, see [Comment update event](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810515104773122).
| | item_list | string[] | Valid only when `event_type` is `COMMENT`.

The IDs of the specific TikTok posts that you no longer want to receive comment update event notifications for.

Max size: 100.

To obtain the IDs of TikTok posts specified for an existing comment update Webhook configuration, use [/business/webhook/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810521289122818).
  • If `event_type` is set to `COMMENT` and this field is provided, you will no longer receive notification of `comment.update` events for the specified posts under the TikTok account or TikTok accounts that authorized the developer app (`app_id`).
  • If `event_type` is set to `COMMENT` and this field is not provided, you will no longer receive notification of `comment.update` events for all posts under the TikTok account or TikTok accounts that authorized the developer app (`app_id`).
| ``` ### Example #### Delete an existing post publishing event Webhook configuration ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/webhook/delete/' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "app_id": "{{app_id}}", "secret": "{{secret}}", "event_type": "VIDEO" }' (/code) ``` #### Delete specific TikTok posts from an existing comment update event Webhook configuration ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/webhook/delete/' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "app_id": "{{app_id}}", "secret": "{{secret}}", "event_type": "COMMENT", "item_list": [ "{{item_id_1}}", "{{item_id_2}}"] }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| app_id | string | ID of your developer application. | #| event_type| string |The type of Webhook event configuration.

Enum values:
  • `VIDEO`: Post publishing events, which provide you with real-time updates on the status of content published via specific TikTok API endpoints.
    • To learn more about the schema and sample payload of the events within this event category, see [Post publishing events](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810515090228226).
  • `COMMENT`: comment update event, including the event `comment.update`.
    • To learn more about the schema and sample payload of the event within this event category, see [Comment update event](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810515104773122).
| #| item_list | string[] | Returned only when `event_type` is `COMMENT` and `item_list` is configured for the developer app (`app_id`).

The IDs of the specific TikTok posts that you will still receive comment update event notifications for.

For example, if you have previously configured the `item_list` as `["{{item_id_1}}","{{item_id_2}}"]` for your developer app and you set `item_list` to `["{{item_id_1}}"]` in the request, the value of this field in the response will be `["{{item_id_2}}"]`.| ``` ### Example #### Delete an existing post publishing event Webhook configuration ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "app_id": "{{app_id}}", "event_type": "VIDEO" } } (/code) ``` #### Delete specific TikTok posts from an existing comment update event Webhook configuration ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "app_id": "{{app_id}}", "event_type": "COMMENT", "item_list": [ "{{item_id_3}}", "{{item_id_4}}" ] } } (/code) ```
